text:
```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'  # every 6 hours
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: sync-ai-connector-docs
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout current repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout AI connectors repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors
          path: agent-connectors
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set branch name
        run: echo "BRANCH=sync-ai-connector-docs-$(date +%s)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Copy AI connector docs
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/ai-agents/connectors
          rsync -av --include='*/' --include='*.md' --exclude='*' agent-connectors/ docs/ai-agents/connectors/
          rm -rf agent-connectors

      - name: Commit changes
        id: commit
        run: |
          git config user.name "Octavia Bot"
          git config user.email "octavia@airbyte.io"
          git checkout -b ${{ env.BRANCH }}
          git add docs/ai-agents/connectors
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit."
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "Sync AI connector docs"
          git push origin ${{ env.BRANCH }}
          echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create PR with Octavia bot
        if: steps.commit.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: airbytehq/octavia-bot@v1
        with:
          title: "Sync AI connector docs"
          body: |
            Automated sync of AI connector documentation from airbyte-agent-connectors.
          head: ${{ env.BRANCH }}
          base: main
          labels: documentation,auto-merge
        env:
          OCTAVIA_BOT_APP_ID: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_APP_ID }}
          OCTAVIA_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY }}
```
